title: Suite-result cache in run_verify.mjs (spec #80 P7)
action: Add a content-hash suite-result cache to scripts/run_verify.mjs: (1) for each suite, compute sha256 over the sorted content hashes of its impact-registry closure files (reuse the existing closure walk; EXTRA_SUITES entries with no registry closure hash their entry file + args). (2) Cache file .bee/logs/verify-cache.json {suiteLabel: {closure_sha, at, result:'green'}} — written only after a GREEN suite run; red never cached. Fail-open: unreadable/corrupt cache = empty cache, never a crash. (3) On a run, a suite whose closure_sha matches its cached green entry is SKIPPED with a visible line 'CACHED green <label> (closure unchanged)'; summary line reports counts run/cached. (4) Scope: applies to impacted runs AND full local runs; DISABLED when process.env.CI is set or --no-cache passed; --cache-clear wipes the file. (5) Never cache suites whose closure includes files with uncommitted changes? NO — content hash already reflects working-tree bytes; document that in a comment. Keep the diff additive: no change to suite discovery, ordering, or LIVE_BUNDLE_GROUP semantics.

truths: A second identical local run reports every previously-green suite as CACHED and runs 0 of them; editing any closure file re-runs exactly the affected suites.
Red result is never written to the cache; CI env disables the cache entirely; --no-cache and --cache-clear work.
Corrupt/missing cache file degrades to cache-miss silently (fail-open).
prohibitions: Do NOT alter which suites are discovered or their run order when cache is cold.
Do NOT touch triggerCiDelegation or the impacted-cap logic.

trace.outcome: Added a content-hash suite-result cache to run_verify.mjs: closure_sha keyed on the sorted content hashes of each suite's impact-registry closure (reused via buildRegistry(), not reimplemented), stored in .bee/logs/verify-cache.json only after a green run. Second identical run prints 'CACHED green <label> (closure unchanged)' and skips execution; a closure-file edit forces a re-run; red is never cached; CI env and --no-cache both disable the cache outright; --cache-clear wipes it; a corrupt/missing cache file fails open to a miss. Applies uniformly to both full/--only and --impacted runs via the shared runSelectedSuites tail. Regenerated scripts/impact-registry.json (pre-existing drift, fixed as a required side effect).
deviations: - Regenerated `scripts/impact-registry.json` (`node scripts/impact_registry.mjs --write`). This file drifted from `scripts/run_verify.mjs`'s SUITES export as soon as run_verify.mjs was edited (the registry is a content-derived cache of the same closure walk this cell reuses), and the drift-check suite (`scripts/impact_registry.mjs --check`, an EXTRA_SUITES chain member) would otherwise fail. Confirmed via `git stash` that a small unrelated 10-line drift (a missing `scripts/skill_budget_fence.mjs` self-entry) already existed on `main` before this cell touched anything — pre-existing repo debt, fixed as a side effect of the required regen rather than a scope expansion.
